name: acne-common-scope-comparison-protocol
status: fixed before any common-scope number is computed
nature: diagnostic comparison on the same 28 DEV photos with AI engineering layer-1 labels; not an independent test, expert validation or product acceptance

scope.mask: frozen layer-1 reviewed-skin masks (layer1-masks, hashes in layer-1 JSON); unchanged; 22 photos have a non-empty mask
scope.targets: in-scope TARGET = layer-1 TARGET whose point lies inside the reviewed mask (same rule for every target, found or missed)
scope.outOfScopeTargets: TARGETs outside the mask (empty-mask photos, or excluded areas) are reported with reasons and are not counted; predictions within r of them are reported as near-out-of-scope-target (neither hit nor false)

rows.step0-final: stored Step0 product-chain final boxes (infer-step0.jsonl; equal to the trace)
rows.step0-before-filter: Step0 conf .30 + NMS .30 boxes recorded in audit-results/acne-step0-trace (nms), before principled_accepted_boxes (region/anatomical filter); diagnostic only, not a candidate
rows.dewiin-anyacne/tiles: verified re-generated stored rows (acne-external-stored-rows-regen, sha ac06add3)

settingsNote: third-party rows keep their own settings (ultralytics conf .25, NMS IoU .7, class map, imgsz 384 tiles + box NMS .30 merge); Step0 conf .30 / NMS .30; not a controlled architecture comparison

scoring.matching: one-to-one, max cardinality then min distance, against in-scope TARGETs only
scoring.unmatched: duplicate (within r of a matched in-scope TARGET) / near out-of-scope TARGET / on other category / on UNCERTAIN / false (inside reviewed mask) / unreviewed (inside face oval, outside mask) / non-skin (outside face oval) / unreviewed photo (empty mask)
scoring.layer2: post-hoc layer-2 codes are shown only as a separate view and never change layer-1 counts

extras: targets found before the Step0 filter but removed by it
